instruction: We start off facing a kitchen sink and some cabinets. We are going to turn around, leaving the laundry room. Take one step into the hallway. Once we are in the hallway, we will take a left and go to the top of the stairs. At the top of the stairs, you'll see a door that opens. Go through the doorway and out to your left. We are now outside. And take a right where you are in the middle of the patio area with the wall way on your left hand side. The furniture, the sectional furniture will be on your right hand side. When you are in the middle, you have reached your destination.
